name: devbox
description: Distributes the Devbox agent skill — a Docker-based developer environment manager. The skill teaches AI agents how to detect a Devbox project, inspect services, look up configuration via the built-in `devbox docs` subsystem, and respect the read/mutation permission boundary.

plugins.name: devbox
plugins.description: Navigator skill for Devbox projects. Activates when working in a project containing `devbox.yml`. Teaches agents how to use `devbox status`, `devbox validate`, `devbox docs`, and the deploy / runtime command boundary.
